items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I worked with Tony Amarica about two or three weeks, you know, on the boat with him.

ctx.x: What about the river boats? Did you ever work on them ever?

Well, they were on the steaming capitol on the... well I worked with different bands, you know? Mm-hmm. In fact, when I came back from Hollywood, I worked with Tony Amarica about two or three weeks, you know, on the boat with him.
